task: Variance MVP Phase 03 memory backend: migration 0006, additive memory contracts, regression checks, scope rule, three reference firms

scenarios.scenario: Replay of an already-recorded answer (with assertion) when the firm is at the cap returns regression_check_cap instead of the original success
scenarios.test: pnpm --filter @aduin/worker test variance-regression-no-cross-firm (should refuse over the cap, and answer a replay at the cap with the stored result)
scenarios.output: 9 passed; replay -> 200 with the original body, active checks stay 20
scenarios.rationale: replayResponse runs before the cap pre-check; the audit UNIQUE key blocks a second check/#rc row

scenarios.scenario: A forged client op id X:rc or X#rc collides with or pre-empts the derived audit id X#rc of answer X
scenarios.test: pnpm --filter @aduin/worker test variance-regression-no-cross-firm (forged X:rc is an ordinary id and X#rc is refused)
scenarios.output: X:rc accepted as ordinary id (its own row X:rc#rc), X#rc refused 400 invalid_request (id_charset), X's derived row X#rc present; 2 checks
scenarios.rationale: '#' is outside ID_RE and parseWith enforces ID_RE on client_op_id; derived ids are server-built

scenarios.scenario: An assertion sent with scope fund or without scope creates a regression check
scenarios.test: pnpm --filter @aduin/worker test variance-answer-intent-rule; variance-regression-no-cross-firm (a check is never created without firm_template)

scenarios.scenario: Lookup for firm B in workspace A returns firm A checks
scenarios.rationale: SELECT binds law_firm_id from the request firm and workspace_id from the cookie

scenarios.scenario: Lookup in workspace B returns workspace A checks, or a check binds to another workspace's answer
scenarios.output: [] in workspace B; FOREIGN KEY constraint failed
scenarios.rationale: workspace_id from the cookie only; composite FK (workspace_id, source_answer_id)

scenarios.scenario: Client sets statement_text, law_firm_id or source_fund_name, or an unnormalized/sensitive label
scenarios.output: statement built server-side; label masked then normalized; no digit run stored
scenarios.rationale: none of these are request fields; firm from the question row, fund from the run

scenarios.scenario: Unbounded checks or unbounded lookup cost
scenarios.output: cap 20 per firm per workspace; one bounded SELECT
scenarios.rationale: route pre-check + trigger backstop with three-way literal parity

scenarios.scenario: A sandbox holding a regression_check aborts the hourly purge batch
scenarios.output: workspace and check gone; younger workspace's check kept

scenarios.scenario: Writes to the demo workspace through the new table
